name: Data Browser Storage Tank (Web)
implementation_notes: StorageTankRecordService/Controller/routes/factories/models/migrations are shared infrastructure for all 3 web Storage Tank screens (096/106/116), mirroring EffluentPlantRecordService's precedent -- reported under this screen since it is first in the implementation sequence. Models/migrations were already generated in an earlier (Phase 1/entity-models) pass and survived the crash that interrupted this task; this pass verified them against the service/controller code and found them consistent, requiring no changes

Storage Tank follows the same hourly-grid (dynamic add-row/remove-row, 1..24 rows, unique + strictly ascending canonical time_slot) pattern as Effluent Plant -- create()/update()/listRecords()/export()/getDetail(), plus canonicalTimeSlots() helper returning 24 'HH:00' strings starting 07:00

filled_slot_count computed via withCount() with an inner OR-whereNotNull constraint across all 17 non-time_slot columns (cpo_sounding_depth_mm, water_dip_bottom_depth_mm, net_oil_depth_mm, oil_temperature_top_c, oil_temperature_middle_c, oil_temperature_bottom_c, average_temperature_c, calculated_volume_m3, calculated_weight_mt, ffa_percent, moisture_content_percent, impurities_dirt_percent, dobi_index, steam_heating_valve_status, tank_structural_condition, inspector_name, findings) -- mirrors EffluentPlantRecordService's filled_slot_count pattern; this station has NO identifying/context columns to exclude (no shift/inspector_id equivalent), so all 17 columns participate

IMPORTANT -- enum empty-string-vs-null: 1 of the 17 detail columns (steam_heating_valve_status) is backed by a SQLite CHECK constraint (Laravel enum()) that rejects an empty string. StorageTankRecordService::normalizeDetails() coerces '' to null for this column specifically before validation/persistence -- the same mitigation Kernel Dispatch/Effluent Plant needed for their own enum columns. This was already implemented correctly in the pre-existing (crash-survived) service code -- verified against a dedicated unit test, no fix needed

UNLIKE Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant: Storage Tank has NO operational-target reference table -- no seeder, no model, no Target Operasional section anywhere in this station's 6 screens, per this task's explicit scope

The Storage Tank tile in production-process-activity.blade.php (screen-035) already existed as an active-styled tile pointing to route('data.storage-tank') -- verified against the pre-existing (crash-survived) blade file, no changes needed

tests/Feature/ProductionProcessActivityTest.php (pre-existing, shared) already reflects Storage Tank's active routing (10 active station tiles, 4 remaining unrouted) -- verified by running the full suite, no changes needed
StationFactory::storageTank() state already existed (mirrors processWater()/effluentPlant() exactly) for this screen's and screen-116's test suites -- verified, no changes needed

Ran the full backend test suite (`php artisan test`) after resuming this task: 1794 passed (0 failed), confirming no regression to any pre-existing screen. Storage-Tank-specific tests (`--filter=StorageTank`): 90 passed (0 failed) -- 33 unit (StorageTankRecordServiceTest), 7 integration (Feature/Api/DataBrowserStorageTankTest), 5 component (Feature/Livewire/DataBrowserStorageTankTest), reported under this screen; remaining 45 Storage Tank tests reported under screen-106/screen-116 below

deferred_items.description: The mobile 'Sinkronisasi' button (Station List, screen-006) does not push locally-entered Storage Tank records to POST /api/storage-tank-records -- unlike Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant/Process Water/Kernel Dispatch/CPO Dispatch/Effluent Plant, which each have a syncStorageTankRecords()-equivalent function wired into syncService.ts's syncAllRecords()
deferred_items.reason: Out of this 6-screen task's explicit scope; the most recent precedent station (Effluent Plant) made the same deferral for the same reason. The route itself is already dual-guarded ('auth:web,sanctum' + operator role, see routes/api.php) so this is purely a mobile syncService.ts addition, not a backend change, when picked up later.
